outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of US and MRI signs for detecting placenta accreta spectrum (PAS)
Agreement between US and MRI in diagnosing PAS
cohort: 39 women with placenta previa (placental edge ≤2 cm from the internal uterine orifice, ≥26(0/7) weeks' gestation)
finding: Ultrasound and MRI showed substantial agreement in the antenatal diagnosis of clinically significant placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) in women with placenta previa, particularly in those with anterior placentas.
